description: Phase 3 sweep S10 (E14): multi-step prediction, horizon 2 and 3 after a 3-step context. Context-preserving circuits A (sequential, chain rule, no interference) and B (context-controlled RY layers with CZ chains, 2 and 3 layers), the paper HEA (4 layers on all qubits) and the classical baselines on path outcomes. QBGU, SWAP-test loss, 3000 SPSA iterations x 10,000 shots, exact loading. Raw and MA5 data. Horizon-1 references: e11_qstl_cc1(_ma5) and the baselines. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T + horizon windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final iteration for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
